Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Curated projects, the repository behind each, and the last sync job

ProjectDetail.notFoundDescription: This project no longer exists, or the link points at another one.
ProjectDetail.curationDescription: The fields this console owns, as opposed to the ones GitHub reports
ProjectDetail.repositoryDescription: What GitHub last reported for the repository behind this project
ProjectDetail.skillsDescription: SKILL.md documents synced from this project
ProjectDetail.noSkills: No skills synced for this project yet.
ProjectDetail.syncJobsDescription: The last {count} sync runs of this project
ProjectDetail.noJobs: No sync jobs for this project yet.
ProjectDetail.authorsDescription: The people credited on this project
ProjectDetail.noAuthors: No authors linked to this project yet.
ProjectDetail.readmeDescription: The document stored for this repository, with its Chinese translation when one has been produced
ProjectDetail.readmeMissing: No README is stored for this repository yet. A resync fetches it from GitHub.
ProjectDetail.resyncStarted: Resync started. This page will update when it finishes.
ProjectDetail.resyncFailed: The resync could not be started
ProjectDetail.assetsDescription: Images mirrored into the object store, so they keep resolving after a repository is renamed or deleted
ProjectDetail.latestReleaseDescription: The most recent release GitHub reported
ProjectDetail.noRelease: No release recorded for this repository yet.
ProjectDetail.packagesDescription: Published npm packages and their measured bundle size
ProjectDetail.historyDescription: The last {count} months recorded by the star snapshots
ProjectDetail.addPackageDescription: The npm name this project publishes. A scoped name is one value: @scope/name.
ProjectDetail.addPackageHint: Metadata is filled in by the next package task run, so the version and downloads appear a little later.
ProjectDetail.removePackageDescription: The project stops publishing this package. The package itself is kept with its version, downloads and bundle size, so adding the name back later restores all of it.
ProjectDetail.trendsDescription: Stargazers gained, from the stargazer sweep. A gap means the month was not swept, not that growth stopped.
ProjectDetail.trendNoMonthlyHistory: No monthly star history has been recorded for this repository yet. A stargazer sweep fills it in.
ProjectDetail.trendNoWeeklyHistory: No weekly star history has been recorded for this repository yet.
ProjectDetail.trendHint: Select a bar to read its value.

CreateProject.description: Paste a GitHub repository URL. Its metadata, README and skills are fetched immediately.
CreateProject.urlError: Enter an owner and repository, or a full GitHub URL.

DeleteProject.title: Delete {name}?
DeleteProject.description: This removes the project and every skill, snapshot and package recorded for it. It cannot be undone.
DeleteProject.confirmLabel: Type the project name to confirm

EditProject.title: Edit project
EditProject.description: Correct the curated fields. Changing a description or homepage marks it as an override, so a later resync will not undo your edit.
EditProject.invalidUrl: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL, or leave the field empty.

Authors.title: Authors
Authors.description: Everyone with a curated repository, ordered by followers. An author comes from the repository owner, so a profile is only as good as the last refresh.
Authors.incompleteCount: {count, plural, one {# author has} other {# authors have}} no profile fetched yet — use the refresh button on the row.

Repos.title: Repositories
Repos.description: Every recorded repository, and which ones nothing points at. An orphan still costs a refresh a day.
Repos.createDescription: Reads the repository from GitHub and starts tracking it. It is recorded whether or not anything points at it yet.
Repos.createUnparseable: That is not a GitHub repository. Try a URL or an owner/name pair.
Repos.createFetchFailed: GitHub could not be read for that repository. Check the name, and that the token can see it if it is private.
Repos.editDescription: The description and homepage belong to GitHub. Changing either here marks it as hand-set, so the daily refresh leaves it alone until you clear it back.
Repos.release: Hand back to GitHub — the next refresh will overwrite this
Repos.deleteDescription: This removes the stored repository data. It can be added again by syncing it.
Repos.deleteDescriptionCascades: {count, plural, one {# project points} other {# projects point}} at this repository and will be deleted with it, along with their tags, skills and sync history.
Repos.deleteArmPrompt: Deleting it is the only way to remove them from the console. This cannot be undone.
Repos.deleteSucceeded: Deleted {name} and {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}

Console.title: My repositories
Console.description: The repositories you have added. Publishing one is an administrator's decision; adding one here is all you need to do.

RepoDetail.notFoundDescription: This repository no longer exists, or the link points at another one.
RepoDetail.readOnlyDescription: You can read everything recorded about this repository. Editing, refreshing and deleting are an administrator's job, in the operator console.
RepoDetail.repositoryDescription: What GitHub last reported, and when this site recorded it
RepoDetail.linkedProjectsDescription: The projects curated from this repository. No project here is not a problem, only that nobody has published it yet.
RepoDetail.noProjects: No project points at this repository yet.
RepoDetail.historyDescription: Star history for the last {count} months
RepoDetail.submittersDescription: Everyone who has submitted this repository. Who submitted it is public; what each of them wrote about it is not, and only this console shows it.
RepoDetail.noSubmitters: Nobody has submitted this repository through the console.
RepoDetail.yourSubmissionDescription: Your own record for this repository. No other account can read it, and you cannot read theirs.
RepoDetail.notSubmitted: You have not submitted this repository.
RepoDetail.platformStateDescription: What the platform has done with this repository. Every submitter sees the same answer, because it is a fact about the repository rather than about them.
RepoDetail.pin: Pin to the top of my list
RepoDetail.notePlaceholder: Why you submitted this, what you want tracked, when to stop…
RepoDetail.noteVisibility: Only you can read this. Other submitters see that you submitted the repository, not what you wrote.

Users.title: Users
Users.description: Every account on this deployment, with what it has submitted and how many sessions it is holding open
Users.searchPlaceholder: Search name, email or phone number

UserDetail.notFoundDescription: This account no longer exists, or the link points at another one.
UserDetail.accountDescription: Identity, verification state and the role that decides which console this account reaches
UserDetail.sessionsDescription: Every session this account holds. The newest one is at the top.
UserDetail.noSessions: This account has no sessions — nobody is signed in as it.
UserDetail.providersDescription: The credentials this account can sign in with. Secrets are never sent to the browser; only whether one exists.
UserDetail.noProviders: No credentials recorded, which should not happen for an account that exists.
UserDetail.submissionsDescription: Every repository this account asked to be tracked, with what the platform has done about each one
UserDetail.noSubmissions: This account has not submitted any repository.
UserDetail.yourRelationDescription: How this account has set aside its own submission. Nobody else can see this.
UserDetail.platformStateDescription: What the platform has done with the repository. The same answer for every submitter — this is not per person.
UserDetail.selfDemotionRefused: You cannot remove your own administrator role. Ask another administrator.

Sessions.title: Sessions
Sessions.description: Every signed-in session on this deployment, and where it came from. Revoking one takes effect on the account's next request.
Sessions.searchPlaceholder: Search email, phone number, IP or user agent
Sessions.revokeDescription: That account is signed out of this device immediately. Every other session of the same account keeps working.
Sessions.revokeAllDescription: Every session of this account is ended, including this one, and it has to sign in again on every device. This cannot be undone.
Sessions.revokedAll: Signed out of {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}

SessionDetail.notFoundDescription: This session no longer exists — revoking it removes the row, so a stale link lands here.
SessionDetail.sessionDescription: Where this sign-in came from and when it stops working
SessionDetail.accountDescription: The account this session acts for
SessionDetail.otherSessionsDescription: Every session of the same account. This is how you tell whether someone else is signed in elsewhere.
SessionDetail.noOtherSessions: This is the account's only session.
SessionDetail.revokeDescription: Every session of this account is ended, including this one, and it has to sign in again on every device. This cannot be undone.
SessionDetail.signedOutEverywhere: Signed {name} out of {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}

TaskDetail.notFoundDescription: This task no longer exists, or the link points at another one.

TaskDetail.statisticsDescription: Every run this task has ever recorded, counted by outcome
TaskDetail.historyDescription: The {count} most recent runs, newest first. Select one to read its result and logs.
TaskDetail.noResult: This run recorded no structured result.
TaskDetail.risingStarsYearDescription: Leave empty to rebuild the last complete year.
TaskDetail.skipNoData: there is no data for this period yet

AuthorDetail.projectsDescription: The projects credited to this author. One author can be credited on several.
AuthorDetail.noProjects: No project is credited to this author yet.
